resources.string: A few simple steps, then you are ready to watch and read.
Choose a light or dark look, or follow your phone. You can change it anytime.
These permissions enable useful features. You can continue without granting them.
Recommended releases are the simplest choice. Previews also include features to try early.
Start fresh or pick up where you left off
Already used Nyanime? Bring back your library, progress and settings. Otherwise, tap Start Nyanime.
Could not save your choice. Please try again.

The Nyanime folder is created automatically in app storage, without file permissions. Downloads saved here are removed if you uninstall the app. You can choose a personal folder later in Settings → Data and storage.
Your existing folder is available. Your files stay in their current location.
Could not prepare the folder. Check available space and access, then retry. An existing folder will not be replaced automatically.
Install the extensions you want from More → Store. Addons are separate apps for optional features; nothing is installed automatically.
New releases, download progress and ready-to-install updates. Android lets you choose which notifications to receive.
Let Nyanime open the installer for app updates and extensions. Android always asks you to confirm installation.
Useful for downloads and release checks when the screen is off. Allowing this may use more battery; Android can still delay background work.
No permission is required to finish setup. You can manage them later in Android settings.
This setting could not be opened. You can enable it later from Android app settings.
Find a backup on this phone or choose a .nyabk or .tachibk file. Check its contents before restoring.
Connect your Telegram account to find your saved backups. Sign-in only starts when you choose this option.
You can restore a backup later in Settings.
Downloaded videos and manga pages are not included in backups. Nothing is overwritten before you confirm.
Some data could not be restored. Check the restore screen for details.
